asr.full_text: When I left the Army, transitioning into civilian life wasn't easy. You've lived everything military and now you're going into a total and complete unknown. I was basically bomb squad, protecting and serving the President, Vice President and distinguished dignitaries. I was an electronic technician. I took care of medical communication devices. Over 200,000 veterans leave our military service every year. They have the aptitude, they have the skills. The biggest challenge they have is to translate those skills into civilian jobs. I was stuck in a career where I didn't see a light at the end of the tunnel. I had better goals and visions for myself. I taught myself to code from my home. It was difficult to just transition into a position that required professional experience. Experience. I definitely struggled from never having to written a resume, never. Had a formal interview. I didn't know how to speak the language. JPMorgan Chase is really focused around how do we help those veterans. Transition. When I found out JPMorgan Chase was hiring veterans, my fate. Changed. The veterans job mission was started with a coalition of companies. Dedicated to hiring veterans post-military to ensure their success. Here at JPMorgan Chase we have a number of different programs to help place our. Veterans in jobs. JPMorgan Chase came up with this apprenticeship program where. You're hired and you're given the training and you're given the time to. Adjust and get all that experience that you would never have. Pathways program is. Pretty incredible. It's a two-year rotational program that allows us to. Explore any space within JPMorgan Chase that we're interested in. Every day I do something new and unique and incredible. I'm in a constant phase of learning. Yeah! Having a group of veterans during this transition process is the most important part. It's a group of people who understand my language, have similar experiences,. Someone we can kind of just lean on when things get tough. It's like working with your family. We hang out together, we program together, you have people you can hold on to, you have. People who know where you're coming from, and you have people who are going in the same. Direction that you are going. It is awesome. You don't have to forget your past to have a future here. JPMorgan Chase just focuses on being the best version of you. Program is not the end, it is the beginning. It creates an opportunity for. You to take advantage of and grow. It is definitely a win-win when we bring. Veterans in. It's the right thing to do but it's also good for business. They're. Going to transform our organization. You.
